alerts.headline: From 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. nightly Wednesday, Nov. 18, through Sunday morning, Nov. 22, and Monday and Tuesday nights, Nov. 23-24, the 148th Avenue Southeast on-ramp to westbound I-90 will close for construction. Signed detours will be available.

The eastbound I-90 off-ramp to Factoria Boulevard will be closed nightly from 9 p.m. – 8 a.m., starting the night of Saturday, Nov. 21 to the morning of Tuesday, Nov. 24. A signed detour will be in place.
From 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. nightly on Monday and Tuesday nights, Nov. 23-24, the westbound I-90 on-ramp from 142nd Place Southeast will close for construction. Signed detours will be available.

From 10 p.m. to 5 a.m. the next morning on Friday and Saturday, Nov. 20-21, and Monday and Tuesday, Nov. 23-24, the northbound and southbound I-405 ramps to eastbound I-90 will close for construction. Signed detours will be available.

The westbound I-90 HOV lane will remain closed near Lakemont Boulevard Southeast for up to a year starting Monday, Nov. 23, to support bridge construction on eastbound I-90. Three lanes of westbound I-90 will remain open through the area.

The eastbound I-90 off-ramp to Factoria Boulevard will be closed nightly from 9 p.m. – 7 a.m., starting the night of Friday, Nov. 20 to the morning of Tuesday, Nov. 24. A signed detour will be in place.

Up to two lanes of southbound I-405 from 112th Avenue Southeast/Lake Washington Boulevard Southeast (milepost 9) to Northeast 44th Street (milepost 7) will be closed overnight from 11 p.m. – 8 a.m., starting the night of Saturday, Nov. 21 to the morning of Sunday, Nov. 22.

From 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. nightly Wednesday, Nov. 18, through Sunday morning, Nov. 22, and Monday and Tuesday nights, Nov. 23-24, up to three lanes of eastbound and westbound I-90 will close between I-405 and 150th Avenue Southeast for construction. Delays are possible each night through the work zone.
Up to four lanes of northbound I-405 from milepost 8.5 to I-90 (milepost 11.2) will be closed overnight from 1 a.m. – 9 a.m. the morning of Sunday, Nov. 22.

Starting at 5 a.m. Monday, Nov. 23, the eastbound I-90 HOV lane will close for up a year between Lakemont Boulevard SE and 17th Avenue NW for bridge construction on eastbound I-90 as part of a fish passage improvement project. 

Three lanes of eastbound I-90 will remain open through this area.

The eastbound I-90 off-ramp to Factoria Boulevard will be closed nightly from 9 p.m. – 5 a.m., starting the night of Sunday, Nov. 15 to the morning of Tuesday, Nov. 24. A signed detour will be in place.

From 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. nightly Wednesday, Nov. 18, through Sunday morning, Nov. 22, and Monday and Tuesday nights, Nov. 23-24, the eastbound I-90 off-ramp to 142nd Place Southeast will close for construction. Signed detours will be available.

The Coal Creek Parkway Southeast on-ramp to northbound I-405 will be closed overnight from 10:30 p.m. – 7:30 a.m., starting the night of Saturday, Nov. 21 to the morning of Sunday, Nov. 22. A signed detour will be in place

From 9 p.m. Saturday, Nov. 21, to 8 p.m. Sunday, Nov. 22, westbound I-90 will reduce to one lane near Lakemont Boulevard Southeast. The westbound off-ramp to Lakemont Boulevard Southeast also will close during the same time. Signed detours will be in place for the ramp closure.

This work will support a shift on westbound I-90 back into its original configuration.
Up to two lanes of northbound SR 527 near I-405 will close nightly between 9 p.m. and 4 a.m. starting Monday night, Nov. 23 to Wednesday morning, Nov. 25.

Sound Transit contractor crews will close several lanes on eastbound and westbound SR 522 between 96th Avenue Northeast and Northeast 180th Street from 9 a.m. to 3 p.m. daily Monday, Nov. 16 through Wednesday, Nov. 25. The right and left lanes will not close at the same time.
One lane of southbound SR 527 and one lane of northbound SR 527 near the I-405 interchange will close from 9 p.m. Sunday, Nov. 22 to 4 a.m. Monday, Nov. 23.
The southbound SR 527 on-ramp to northbound I-405 will close from 8 p.m. Saturday, Nov. 21 to 7 a.m. Sunday, Nov. 22.
The northbound SR 527 on-ramp to northbound I-405 will nightly between 9 p.m. and 4 a.m. starting Monday night, Nov. 23 to Wednesday morning, Nov. 25.
Up to two lanes of southbound SR 527 near I-405 will close from 8 p.m. Saturday, Nov. 21 to 7 a.m. Sunday, Nov. 22.

From 9 p.m. Sunday, Nov. 22, to 5 a.m. Monday, Nov. 23, westbound I-90 will reduce to one lane near 17th Avenue NW. Intermittent rolling slowdowns also are planned during these hours. Delays are likely through the work zone during these hours. 

Contractor crews will shift westbound I-90 back into its original configuration in this area during the nightly lane closure.

Westbound I-90 is reduced to three lanes near the 17th Street Northwest on-ramp to the Lakemont Boulevard off-ramp, with traffic shifts to accommodate construction. The HOV lane is open to all drivers.

Sound Transit contractor crews will close several lanes on eastbound and westbound SR 522 between 61st Avenue Northeast and 73rd Avenue Northeast from 6 a.m. to 3 p.m. daily Monday, Nov. 16 through the afternoon of Wednesday, Nov. 25.
Sound Transit contractor crews will close the right lane on westbound SR 522 at 73rd Avenue Northeast daily and nightly through the next several weeks.
The southbound off-ramp to Northeast 85th Street will be closed overnight from 10 p.m. Saturday, Nov. 21– 6 a.m. Sunday, Nov. 22.
The Northeast 85th Street on-ramp to northbound I-405 will be closed overnight from ?11 p.m. Saturday, Nov. 21- 7 a.m. Sunday, Nov. 22.
The northbound I-405 off-ramp to Northeast 85th Street will be closed, overnight from 11 p.m. Saturday, Nov. 21- 7 a.m. Sunday, Nov. 22.
The Northeast 85th Street on-ramp to southbound I-405 will be closed overnight from 10 p.m. Saturday, Nov. 21- 6 a.m. Sunday, Nov. 22.

Two Express Toll Lanes (ETL’s) and one general purpose lane of northbound I-405 between milepost 18.3 and milepost 19.85 will be closed overnight from 11 p.m. Saturday, Nov. 21- 8:30 a.m. Sunday, Nov. 22.
Up to three lanes of southbound I-405 between milepost 18.11 and milepost 16.45 will be closed overnight from 10 p.m. Saturday, Nov. 21- 7 a.m. Sunday, Nov. 22.
Up to three lanes of northbound I-405 between milepost 17.45 and milepost 18.12 will be closed overnight from 11 p.m. Saturday, Nov. 21- 8:30 a.m. Sunday, Nov. 22.

Two Express Toll Lanes (ETL’s) and one general purpose lane of southbound I-405 between milepost 19.84 and milepost 18.11 will be closed overnight from 10:30 p.m. Saturday, Nov. 21 – 8 a.m. Sunday, Nov. 22.

Sound Transit contractor crews will close the right lane on eastbound Northeast 145th Street between 15th Avenue Northeast and 17th Avenue Northeast from 9 a.m. to 6 p.m. daily Friday, Nov. 13 through the evening of Wednesday, Nov. 25.

Sound Transit contractor crews will close the left lane on eastbound Northeast 145th Street between 28th Avenue Northeast and 30th Avenue Northeast from 7 a.m. to 3 p.m. daily Monday, Nov. 16 through the afternoon of Wednesday, Nov. 25.

From 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. nightly, the left lane of eastbound I-90 will close seven nights a week between East Mercer Way and I-405 for construction beneath the eastbound I-90 Mercer Slough bridge. 

This work will continue through mid-December, with a pause from Nov. 25-30 for holiday travel.
Road work on SR 99 both directions from milepost 0.51 near 59th Ave Ct E to milepost 0.85 near 65th Ave E beginning at 7:35 am on November 17, 2026 until about 5:00 pm on January 29, 2027.

Until further notice, SR 161 is reduced to one lane in each direction between 36th Street East and Dechaux Road East on North Hill due to slide activity. Travelers can expect shifted lanes and congestion approaching North Hill. See the project webpage.

The North Southport Drive on-ramp to southbound I-405 will be closed overnight from 10 p.m. – 8 a.m., starting the night of Saturday, Nov. 21 to the morning of Sunday, Nov. 22. A signed detour will be in place.

The southbound I-5 off-ramp to westbound North Northgate Way, southbound I-5 off-ramp to eastbound North Northgate Way, and westbound North Northgate Way on-ramp to southbound I-5 will be closed overnight on Monday, Nov. 23, and Tuesday, Nov. 24. The ramp closures will begin at 9 p.m. each night until 5 a.m. the following morning.

Northbound I-5 will be reduced to two lanes between Yesler Way and Northeast Ravenna Boulevard from 11 p.m. Monday, Nov. 23, to 4 a.m. Tuesday, Nov. 24, and again from 11 p.m. Tuesday, Nov. 24, to 4 a.m. Wednesday, Nov. 25, for drainage improvements.

From 10 p.m. Tuesday, Nov. 24 to 5 a.m. Wednesday, Nov. 25, the right lane of eastbound Interstate 90 between Rainier Avenue South (milepost 2) and the Mount Baker Tunnel (milepost 4) will be closed for city of Seattle maintenance. At this time, the on-ramp from northbound Rainier Avenue South to eastbound Interstate 90 will be closed.

On Monday, Nov. 23, the I-5 express lanes will be reduced to two lanes across the Ship Canal Bridge beginning at 7 p.m. before fully closing at the regularly scheduled time of 11 p.m.

On Tuesday, Nov. 24, the I-5 express lanes will be reduced to two lanes across the Ship Canal Bridge beginning at 7 p.m. before fully closing at 9 p.m., two hours earlier than normal.

From 10 p.m. Monday, Nov. 23 to 5 a.m. Tuesday, Nov. 24, the right lane of eastbound Interstate 90 between Rainier Avenue South (milepost 2) and the Mount Baker Tunnel (milepost 4) will be closed for city of Seattle maintenance. At this time, the on-ramp from southbound Rainier Avenue South to eastbound Interstate 90 will be closed.

Update 11:46 PM : On SR 900 eastbound & westbound at S 129th St  (MP 8) there is an incident blocking all lanes.  Medical Aid, the Incident Response Team, the State Patrol, and King County Sheriff have arrived on the scene.

On SR 529 northbound & southbound at Snohomish River Bridge (MP 5) all lanes will be closed today at 2:04 AM due to boat traffic.  Drivers should anticipate a delay of up to 30 minutes or consider using an alternate route.

Beginning Sept. 24, 2021 until further notice: The southbound Interstate 5 Silver Lake Rest Area is closed for maintenance indefinitely. There is no access for recreational vehicle dumping at this location.

Nightly from 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. the following morning beginning 9 p.m. Sunday, Nov. 22 to 5 a.m. Thursday, Nov. 26, and again from 9 p.m. Monday, Nov. 30 to 5 a.m. Tuesday, Dec. 1, the right lane of northbound State Route 99 between 112th Street Southwest and Airport Road (milepost 52) will be closed for utility work.

Daily (except Friday, weekends) until further notice from 9 a.m. to 4 p.m. beginning Monday, Nov. 16, one right lane of southbound Interstate 5 from 47th Street Southeast to State Route 526/SR 527 (mileposts 191-189) will close for Sound Transit work. The right lane of the southbound I-5 off-ramp to 41st Street and the right lane of the southbound I-5 on-ramp from Broadway will also close.
From 8 a.m. to noon Tuesday, Nov. 24, the right lane of northbound State Route 527 at Interstate 5 (milepost 11) will close for maintenance. This work may also need to occur on Wednesday, Nov. 25.

Beginning Monday, Sept. 21 until 5 a.m. Friday, Oct. 9: Nightly from 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. (except Saturdays), State Route 203 traffic will alternate with flaggers from US 2 to Main Street (milepost 24) for utilities.
Lowell-Snohomish River Road will alternate traffic near SR 9 beginning Wednesday, Sept. 30.

Daily from 6 a.m. to 2 p.m. on Monday, Nov. 23 and Tuesday, Nov. 24, State Route 96/East Lowell Larimer Road between 27th Avenue East (milepost 5) and 81st Avenue Southeast (milepost 7) will alternate in both directions with flaggers for utilities maintenance.

Construction of a new roundabout will cause occasional delays at the intersection of US 2 and Old Owen Road/Fern Bluff Road near Sultan (milepost 21).

Overnight closures of Fern Bluff Road will begin Monday, Dec. 7.
